ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:2 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface, creating a high-contrast macro distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixels form contiguous patches and streaks primarily on the distal tips and lower-medial margins of both lobes. Vertical white linear streaks are concentrated on the medial region of the left lobe, while a large dark contiguous region dominates the upper central fluke area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 52 degrees and a clearly defined bounding-box depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration map with irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits more jagged, higher-frequency sawtooth peaks compared to the relatively smoother serration profile of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct concave arc from the median notch to the distal tips; the outer lateral margins exhibit a convex sweep trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several high-contrast circular pixel clusters: a pair of ring-like scars on the lower-left lobe and a prominent 'bullseye' (white annulus with a dark center) on the mid-upper distal region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white, unaligned linear pixel streaks (rake marks) are visible on the medial surface of the left lobe and lower-central region of the right lobe, oriented vertically and diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-intensity, textured calcified structures (acorn barnacles) are anchored to the distal-most tips of both the left and right lobes, resulting in highly irregular perimeter boundaries at these points.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'bullseye' pigmentation scar on the right lobe, characterized by a high-intensity white outer ring surrounding a low-intensity central pixel cluster.
